name: tt-model-op-analysis
description: Kernel-op analysis of a tt-metal model test and its portability to a destination architecture: static trace to device ops and program factories, Tracy measurement and TTsim kernel-op tests.

interface.shortDescription: List every kernel op a tt-metal model test runs and how each ports to a destination architecture, statically and with Tracy and TTsim measurements.
interface.longDescription: One skill analyses the kernel ops of a model's entry test and their portability from a source target (P100 or P150) to a destination (P100, P150, Quasar unchanged, an existing Quasar port or a Quasar BF16 projection). The static mode traces every ttnn call at a pinned tt-metal commit to its device op and program factory and decides support per kernel op; the measured phases add a Tracy run of the same test on the source device and TTsim runs of the destination's kernel-op tests, on the same commit. Output is CSV with a per-kernel-op summary and an optional Google Drive upload.
capabilities: Tracy measurement of the entry test
TTsim kernel-op tests on the destination
defaultPrompt: Start a kernel-op analysis: ask me for the mode (static, static + measured, or measured over an existing static run), then run the interactive setup.
